heading: Stories of the Prophets
summary: Stories of the Prophets gathers fifty selected Quran readings across twenty-five named prophets. Open a prophet to read its passages and answer a short reading check. The library keeps brief mentions brief, identifies its selection limits and avoids adding an unsourced biography where the cited passages do not provide one.
steps: Find a prophet by name or use the reading-area filter.
Open the prophet and read the selected passages with their source references.
Try the reading check and save a prophet if you want to revisit it.

questions.question: Are the prophets arranged in historical order?
questions.answer: No. Prophets are listed alphabetically. The order of the catalog does not claim a historical sequence.

questions.question: Does every prophet have a full life story?
questions.answer: No. This is a selected Quran reading library, not a complete biography collection. Where a prophet is mentioned briefly in the selected evidence, the page does not expand that mention into an unsourced life story.
